messages:
noah: Starting v2 rollout us-east at 11:00 UTC. Quick FYI: early telemetry shows a delta in 400s tied to clients not sending api-version header.

deploy-bot: [deploy] v2 -> 60% traffic us-east at 11:02 UTC. Observed: +1.9% 400s, top tag = missing-header.

ravi: gateway routing expects api-version for feature gating. Older proxies strip it. We should avoid global rollback. Propose temporary edge shim inserting api-version: 1.0 when absent.

elle: alternative: tenant pin top affected clients to v1. Which is less blast radius?

ops-bot: recommended: 1) canary shim at edge, 2) 10m monitor, 3) apply tenant pins only if errors persist.

ravi: pushing shim to canary now. config: match missing header -> set api-version: 1.0.

deploy-bot: canary shim active at 11:15 UTC. Monitoring window started.

sara: monitoring shows 400s drop to baseline for canary. No increase in latency or 5xx.

noah: good. Keep shim live and draft a release-note blurb noting header requirement and temporary shim. Elle, can you handle comms?

elle: yes. I'll update release notes + post in #integrations.

ops-bot: reminder: add check in rollback playbook for tenant-pin ordering and documentation link.

noah: plan: widen shim regionally after 20m if stable, remove tenant pins unless users request. Follow-ups: SDK ticket to ensure proxies send header, docs PR, runbook update.

deploy-bot: scheduled widen at 11:40 UTC. Auto-revert if 4xx > 0.5% above baseline for 10m.

ravi: widening now. metrics stable. Removing emergency pin list (none applied).

elle: docs PR created: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/450. Posted integrator note.

noah: thanks team. Closing thread once runbook updated and SDK ticket linked.
